title: It's an interesting place to experience
content: I just recently found out about this Mall World you people have been going to. I apparently wasn't expected. And they didn't want me to stay. Go figure. They were taken aback by what they refer to as "he's midcin" and how "it's strong" and there was something about "it doesn't go away". So surprised one even started touching me to verify I was tangible. I understood them for the most part but there is something they said I didn't have, a device to communicate with them, I was supposed to have it and didn't so they didn't understand me. Oh.. and the security is cool. Big and intimidating looking but soft as charmin. The ones with the red dot quincux logo on the shoulder patch. That alone should tell you a lot about the place. Is the first time I'd ever been to that part you guys are calling Mall World, never came across it before, and if they'd just ignored me I'd likely never go back. Not a threat just expect me next time. Pretty cool place though. I appreciate you making known as somewhere to look for. And btw "midcin" is short for midcingulate cortex. It was just used like a slang so I don't quite know if they were refering to my personal character or referring that the functional strength of my midcingulate cortex wasn't decreasing. If your Mall World, that little almost island paradise that I'd never happened across, is the only place you venture to let it be the only place you do. You are obviously being intercepted and sent to a happy safe place. Trust me when I say there are a lot of far, far worse areas/places. Stay safe and have fun. :) Stick to your Mall World. (:
